The two self-caught subtyping gaps (items 5 and 7 in Bugs found — missing TTable<:opaque-Table and TRow<:opaque-Row) are good evidence of real engagement with soundness rather than hand-waving. The one soft spot is the reducer-extend column, which asserts a declared annotation type without the static checker verifying it against the reducer's real shape, but the report is honest that the underlying reducer binding still carries a runtime-checked annotation (mkReducerAnn) in desugar-post-tc.ts, so this degrades to dynamic-check-backed soundness rather than an outright unsound rule; stack's exact-column-set check is similarly deferred to a runtime raise rather than silently accepted, which is disclosed rather than glossed over.
